errors.text_span: изразени като процент от общата налична енергия, базирана на тонове нефтен еквивалент
errors.evidence: The description omits a crucial part of the metric. The chart shows the energy dependency rate as a "% of net imports in gross available energy", not just "% of total available energy". The machine translation omits "net imports".

errors.text_span: Ос Y е обозначена като „% от нетните вноски в общата налична енергия“
errors.evidence: The Y-axis is not explicitly labeled with this or any other text. It only has numerical values (0-100). The description hallucinates an axis label by using information from the chart's subtitle.
The turquoise line for "Oil and petroleum products" starts at approximately 94% in 2008, not 96%.
The turquoise line for "Oil and petroleum products" ends at approximately 94% in 2018, not 96%.
The pink line for "Natural gas" starts at 70% in 2008, not 72%.

errors.text_span: след това се стабилизира около 55–56% до 2018 г.
errors.evidence: This is an incorrect description of the trend for the blue "All products" line. After its lowest point in 2010 (~55.5%), the line clearly trends upwards, returning to approximately 58% by 2018. It does not stabilize at the lower value.
The description fails to mention that the blue line for "All products" is visibly thicker than the other three lines, which is a distinct visual feature used for emphasis.

errors.text_span: Графиката не показва никакви допълнителни елементи като легенда, освен тази в горния десен ъгъл, или анотации.
errors.evidence: This sentence is contradictory and poorly phrased. It states that the chart does not show a legend, and then immediately qualifies this by saying "except for the one in the upper right corner".
